name: Sticky Nav Bar
description: Top navigation with logo, version dropdown, links, social icons, INSTALL button, and a mobile hamburger.

name: Split Hero
description: Two-column homepage hero: status pill, headline, feature list, CTAs on the left; badges + code card on the right; glow video behind.

name: Page Hero
description: Eyebrow + headline + lead paragraph over a star-field. The standard top of every interior page.

name: Status Pill
description: "// SYSTEM ONLINE" label with a pulsing green Loader. Signals a live state.

name: Code Block Card
description: Terminal-style card with an accent bar, a typewriter command, and a copy button.

name: How It Works
description: Bordered container with corner accents, an embedded demo video, and a 3-up numbered steps grid.

name: Comparison Table
description: Feature-by-feature table contrasting AstroAnimate with alternatives, using check / cross / warn icons.

name: Performance / Architecture Grids
description: Icon + stat + caption cards laid out on a hairline grid.

name: Use-case & Doc-structure Tabs
description: Tabbed panels that swap content in place to show different scenarios.

name: Open-source Panel
description: Two-column block: prose on the left, a stacked key/value badge column (LICENSE, SIZE, RUNTIME) on the right.

name: Principle / Feature Grid
description: Numbered cards (01–06) on a hairline grid describing values or features.

name: Docs Layout
description: Three-column app shell: collapsible grouped sidebar, centered reading column, right "in this page" TOC.

name: Right TOC (scroll-spy)
description: "IN THIS PAGE" rail that highlights the active heading as you scroll.

name: Component Card Grid
description: Catalog of components grouped by category, each card with name, NEW badge, description, and subpath import.

name: Blog Listing
description: A featured post + side cards, a category filter with search, and a dash-separated post list.

name: Article Layout
description: Article header with cover image and author, a sticky table of contents, and a prose body with code blocks, callouts, and comparison tables.

name: FAQ Accordion
description: Questions grouped by category, each a native disclosure with an animated +/− marker.

name: Showcase Grid
description: Cards with a gradient placeholder thumbnail, tags, name, description, and a visit link.

name: Changelog Timeline
description: Vertical timeline with version dots and Added / Changed / Fixed change tags per release.

name: Roadmap Columns
description: Status-grouped columns (Shipped, In Progress, Planned, Exploring) of feature cards with status pills.

name: Support Channels
description: Grid of channel cards plus a numbered "good bug report" checklist and quick links.

name: Contact Form
description: Demo form (no backend) beside a column of contact-method cards.

name: Final CTA Block
description: Centered eyebrow + headline + button pair over a star-field, closing a page.

name: Footer
description: Five-column footer with newsletter signup and a bottom bar showing a live UTC clock.
